title: Customers with all three account types
statementMd:
Which customers hold all three account types (savings, checking, credit)? Show name.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Count distinct account types per customer.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.type) = 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
